verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms CodeRabbit serves an llms.txt at docs.coderabbit.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes pages as .md links. Many doc pages are cited at their markdown (.md) URLs, so an agent can be pointed at clean, agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of how agents actually use these docs, and evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-oriented guidance about the docs.
